title: CRISPR Pipeline parameters
description: Pipeline parameters for single-cell Perturb-seq CRISPR screen processing, guide assignment, inference, and optional evaluation outputs.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define the input samplesheet and output directory.

input.help_text: The samplesheet provides modality-specific FASTQ paths and metadata used by the pipeline, including R1_path, R2_path, file_modality, measurement_sets, seqspec, barcode_onlist, guide_design, and barcode_hashtag_map when hashing is enabled.

outdir.description: Directory where final pipeline outputs are published.

DEMO_MODE.description: Pre-run only: process one complete measurement set from the samplesheet.
DEMO_MODE.help_text: Among measurement_sets IDs containing both scRNA and gRNA rows, selects the set with the fewest distinct scRNA FASTQ paths across R1_path and R2_path. When ENABLE_DATA_HASHING is true, eligible sets must also contain hash rows. Ties are resolved by measurement_sets ID so repeated runs remain stable regardless of samplesheet row order. All lanes/read pairs for the selected set are retained. Demo outputs are prominently marked and must not be used as final full-dataset results.

assay_and_library_options.title: Assay and library options
assay_and_library_options.description: Options describing the assay design, sequencing chemistry, and barcode handling.

ENABLE_DATA_HASHING.description: Enable the hashing branch of the workflow.
ENABLE_DATA_HASHING.help_text: When true, the workflow expects hash modality rows in the samplesheet, runs hashing mapping, filtering, demultiplexing, and uses the hashing dashboard path.

ENABLE_SCRUBLET.description: Run Scrublet doublet detection before guide assignment in non-hashing workflows.

is_10x3v3.description: Use 10x Genomics 3' v3 feature-barcode chemistry for guide or hashing mapping, depending on whether hashing is enabled.
is_10x3v3.help_text: This parameter only changes feature-barcode modalities; RNA mapping always derives chemistry from the RNA seqspec. Case 1: when ENABLE_DATA_HASHING = false and is_10x3v3 = true, mappingGuide uses CHEM=10XV3 with kb --workflow kite:10xFB instead of deriving guide chemistry from the guide seqspec. Case 2: when ENABLE_DATA_HASHING = true and is_10x3v3 = true, mappingGuide remains seqspec-driven, mappingscRNA remains seqspec-driven, and mappingHashing uses CHEM=10XV3 with kb --workflow kite:10xFB. This second case matches the PR #78 hashing/HTO special case for 10x 3' v3 HTO datasets where barcode replacement/translation may be needed so hashing, RNA, and guide barcodes match downstream. When is_10x3v3 = false, guide and hash mapping both derive chemistry from their seqspecs.

reverse_complement_guides.description: Reverse-complement guide spacer sequences while building the guide reference.

spacer_tag.description: Recommended 12 bp sequence immediately upstream of the guide spacer.
spacer_tag.help_text: Use this when the guide spacer is preceded by a constant adapter/tag sequence. A 12 bp tag is recommended because it is usually specific enough to anchor the guide read while still tolerating normal read quality. When provided, mappingGuide preserves the guide read ID from the seqspec but resets the guide feature start/end to 0,0 so kb can search the whole guide read for the tagged spacer. Set null or an empty string to rely strictly on the feature coordinates encoded in the guide seqspec.

is_BaseEditing.description: Use CRISPR-Correct ambiguous guide mapping for base-editing guide libraries.
is_BaseEditing.help_text: Enable only for base-editing assays whose guide reads need ambiguity-aware spacer matching. Standard CRISPRi/a and knockout assays continue to use mappingGuide.

BASEEDITING_method.description: Select the legacy or streaming FLASH base-editing guide mapper.

BASEEDITING_FLASH_tolerance.description: Maximum Hamming distance accepted by the FLASH guide matcher.

BASEEDITING_FLASH_guide_len.description: Guide length used by FLASH; zero infers it from metadata.

BASEEDITING_FLASH_device.description: FLASH matcher device: auto, cpu, cuda, cuda:N, or a GPU index.

BASEEDITING_FLASH_fastq_chunk_size.description: Number of FASTQ read pairs streamed per FLASH chunk.

BASEEDITING_FLASH_gpu_read_chunk.description: Dense matcher sub-chunk size used on the selected device.

scrna_workflow.description: kb count workflow used for scRNA mapping.
scrna_workflow.help_text: standard runs regular mature transcript counting against the selected transcriptome index. nac runs nascent-aware counting by passing kb --workflow nac with both the cDNA reference and nascent reference, allowing the RNA modality to capture nascent/unspliced signal in addition to mature transcript signal. Use nac only when the selected reference bundle includes the nascent index expected by the pipeline.

use_multimapping.description: Pass kb count multimapping mode to scRNA mapping and preserve that setting during AnnData concatenation.

replace_barcodes.description: Enable barcode replacement during RNA and guide mapping.
replace_barcodes.help_text: This is the CC-Perturb-seq barcode correction strategy. When true, RNA and guide mapping pass bc_replacement_file to kb count with -r so barcodes can be translated to a shared/corrected barcode namespace before modality overlap. Downstream concatenation then reads counts_unfiltered_modified outputs. Leave false for standard 10x-style data where RNA and guide barcodes already match.

bc_replacement_file.description: Barcode replacement table used when replace_barcodes is true.

DUAL_GUIDE.description: Enable dual-guide-aware aggregation when concatenating guide-assigned MuData.

Multiplicity_of_infection.description: Expected CRISPR screen multiplicity of infection.
Multiplicity_of_infection.help_text: Stored in guide.uns['moi'] during MuData creation. If set to high, downstream guide assignment and perturbation inference are allowed to represent cells with multiple guide assignments, which is appropriate for high-MOI screens. If set to low, the pipeline records a low-MOI design where most cells are expected to carry zero or one perturbation; this affects how guide assignment and interpretation of perturbation-level tests should be handled. If a non high/low value is provided, create_mdata.py estimates high versus low from the average number of detected guides per cell.

use_igvf_reference.description: Use the prebuilt IGVF transcriptome reference for RNA mapping.
use_igvf_reference.help_text: When true, the RNA mapping reference is taken from the IGVF reference path and REFERENCE_transcriptome is ignored for that mapping step.

REFERENCE_transcriptome.description: Transcriptome name passed to kb-python reference download when not using the prebuilt IGVF reference.
REFERENCE_transcriptome.help_text: Ignored for RNA mapping when use_igvf_reference = true because the pipeline uses the prebuilt IGVF reference bundle. Set use_igvf_reference = false when you want this transcriptome setting to control reference download.

REFERENCE_gtf_download_path.description: URL for the GTF annotation downloaded when REFERENCE_gtf_local_path does not exist.
REFERENCE_gtf_download_path.help_text: Ignored for reference selection when use_igvf_reference = true. The GTF is still used by preprocessing and cis-pair construction; if REFERENCE_gtf_local_path exists it takes priority over this URL.

REFERENCE_gtf_local_path.help_text: Ignored for RNA reference selection when use_igvf_reference = true, but still checked by preprocessing/inference for gene annotation and cis-pair construction. If this file exists at runtime, it is used instead of downloading REFERENCE_gtf_download_path.

quality_control_options.title: Quality control options
quality_control_options.description: Cell, gene, and barcode filtering options used during preprocessing and QC reporting.

QC_min_genes_per_cell.description: Minimum detected genes required to keep a cell when QC_barcode_filter is none.
QC_min_genes_per_cell.help_text: A gene is considered present in a cell when its count is greater than zero in the RNA AnnData matrix. This parameter is passed to scanpy.pp.filter_cells(min_genes=...) and is only active when QC_barcode_filter = 'none'. When knee or knee2 filtering is enabled, total RNA UMI depth selects cells first and the min-genes cell filter is skipped.

QC_min_counts_per_cell.description: Minimum total RNA UMI count required to keep a cell after barcode calling.
QC_min_counts_per_cell.help_text: This library-size filter is applied after none, knee, or knee2 barcode selection and therefore remains active when QC_min_genes_per_cell is skipped. Set to 0 to disable it.

QC_min_cells_per_gene.description: Minimum cell support required to keep a gene.
QC_min_cells_per_gene.help_text: Fraction of retained cells required to keep a gene, passed to preprocessing and MuData guide-assignment aggregation. It must be in [0, 1); zero keeps genes detected in at least one cell.

TAPSEQ_QC_MODE.help_text: When enabled, preprocessing removes only genes undetected in every retained cell rather than applying the standard 10-cell prefilter. Set QC_min_cells_per_gene to a small fraction (for example 0.000001) to retain all observed TAP-seq genes after MuData aggregation.

QC_pct_mito.description: Maximum mitochondrial read percentage allowed per cell.

QC_batch_col.description: Observation metadata column used as the batch label in additional QC plots.

QC_barcode_filter.description: RNA barcode filtering strategy based on total cell RNA UMI depth.
QC_barcode_filter.help_text: The preprocessing script sums RNA UMIs per cell, sorts barcodes from highest to lowest total_gene_umis, plots log1p(total_gene_umis) versus barcode rank, and estimates up to two knees. 'knee' uses the first/basic knee: the barcode-rank point with maximum distance from the line joining the highest-UMI and lowest-UMI barcodes. This is more permissive and keeps cells with total_gene_umis greater than or equal to the UMI count at that first knee. 'knee2' first restricts the curve to the high-UMI segment before knee1 and then finds a second/advanced knee using spline curvature; this is stricter and is intended to remove additional low-quality or background barcodes inside the initially retained population. 'none' disables UMI-knee filtering and instead applies QC_min_genes_per_cell. If the requested knee cannot be determined, barcode filtering is skipped with a log message; preprocessing then continues, and because QC_barcode_filter is not 'none', the min-genes cell filter is also skipped. Cells tied at the selected UMI threshold are retained.

GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_method.description: Method used to assign guide RNAs to cells.

GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_capture_method.description: Guide capture method recorded in MuData and passed to CLEANSER when GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_method is cleanser.
GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_capture_method.help_text: CLEANSER supports crop-seq and direct-capture models. The pipeline passes this value directly as a CLEANSER command-line flag: crop-seq becomes --crop-seq and direct-capture becomes --direct-capture. Use crop-seq for CROP-seq-style libraries where the guide RNA is captured through the transcript, and direct-capture for direct guide-capture assays.

GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_cleanser_probability_th.description: Probability threshold passed to Cleanser guide assignment.

GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_SCEPTRE_probability_thr.description: Posterior probability threshold for SCEPTRE mixture-based guide assignment.

GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_SCEPTRE_n_em_rep.description: Number of EM initializations passed to SCEPTRE guide assignment.

inference_options.title: Inference options
inference_options.description: Differential expression and perturbation inference settings.

INFERENCE_method.help_text: default runs local SCEPTRE, local PerTurbo, global PerTurbo, and writes the merged local/global output tables. sceptre runs SCEPTRE only. perturbo runs PerTurbo only. sceptre,perturbo runs both methods on the same cis pair set.

INFERENCE_input_mudata.description: Input MuData file for -entry INFERENCE_FROM_MUDATA runs.

INFERENCE_target_guide_pairing_strategy.description: Strategy used to define guide-target pairs before inference.
INFERENCE_target_guide_pairing_strategy.help_text: default builds cis pairs using intended targets and the configured max distance. by_distance builds distance-based cis pairs. predefined_pairs uses INFERENCE_predefined_pairs_to_test.

INFERENCE_predefined_pairs_to_test.description: CSV file containing predefined guide-target pairs.

INFERENCE_max_target_distance_bp.description: Maximum genomic distance, in base pairs, used when constructing cis guide-target pairs.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_DEVICE.description: Device requested for PerTurbo v2 inference.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_MAX_CHUNK_CELLS.description: Maximum cells sent to a PerTurbo v2 fit at once.
INFERENCE_PERTURBO_MAX_CHUNK_CELLS.help_text: This is the primary GPU-memory knob for local and global runs; PerTurbo minibatching is intentionally disabled by the pipeline.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_LOCAL_MAX_CHUNK_CELLS.description: Maximum cells per PerTurbo v2 local/cis chunk.
INFERENCE_PERTURBO_LOCAL_MAX_CHUNK_CELLS.help_text: Overrides the local/cis process only, allowing larger two-GPU local chunks without changing or invalidating global/trans inference.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_LOCAL_PARALLEL_FITS.description: Fit local/cis element and guide PerTurbo v2 models concurrently.
INFERENCE_PERTURBO_LOCAL_PARALLEL_FITS.help_text: Requires two visible GPUs. This affects only local/cis inference; global/trans inference is unchanged.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_ELEMENT_GPU.description: CUDA device ID used by the local/cis element fit when parallel fits are enabled.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_GUIDE_GPU.description: CUDA device ID used by the local/cis guide fit when parallel fits are enabled.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_JAX_CACHE_DIR.description: Directory used for persistent JAX compilation caches.
INFERENCE_PERTURBO_JAX_CACHE_DIR.help_text: Use a persistent fast-disk path to reuse compiled programs across task retries. Element and guide fits use separate subdirectories.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_NUM_STEPS_CONTROL.description: SVI steps for the PerTurbo v2 control/baseline fit.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_NUM_STEPS_BETAS.description: SVI steps for PerTurbo v2 perturbation-effect fits.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_SAVE_MODEL_PARAMS.description: Save PerTurbo v2 fitted model bundles in addition to pipeline-compatible result tables.
INFERENCE_PERTURBO_SAVE_MODEL_PARAMS.help_text: Off by default to keep pipeline outputs smaller.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_SIZE_FACTOR_MODE.description: Size-factor handling passed to PerTurbo v2.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_LIKELIHOOD.description: Likelihood family passed to PerTurbo v2.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_PRIOR.description: Perturbation-effect prior passed to PerTurbo v2.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_CRT.description: Run PerTurbo's conditional randomization test beside the Bayesian effect estimates; its p-value becomes perturbo_p_value.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_CRT_POOL.description: Cells a perturbation is tested against. from-moi follows Multiplicity_of_infection (high: every cell, each element a marginal association; low: the pure control cells plus the perturbation's own). auto lets PerTurbo measure the design from the median guides per cell.

INFERENCE_PERTURBO_GLOBAL_RESULTS_FORMAT.description: Serialization format for global PerTurbo result tables and chunk intermediates.
INFERENCE_PERTURBO_GLOBAL_RESULTS_FORMAT.help_text: Use parquet for substantially faster result-table reads and writes. The PerTurbo execution environment must provide pyarrow.

INFERENCE_SCEPTRE_side.description: Alternative-hypothesis side passed to SCEPTRE inference.

INFERENCE_SCEPTRE_grna_integration_strat.description: Guide RNA integration strategy passed to SCEPTRE inference.

INFERENCE_SCEPTRE_resampling_approximati.description: Resampling approximation passed to SCEPTRE inference.

INFERENCE_SCEPTRE_control_group.description: Control group strategy passed to SCEPTRE inference.

INFERENCE_SCEPTRE_resampling_mechanism.description: Resampling mechanism passed to SCEPTRE inference.

INFERENCE_SCEPTRE_CHUNK_MODE.description: SCEPTRE MuData gene-chunking mode before inference.
INFERENCE_SCEPTRE_CHUNK_MODE.help_text: auto chunks when the cell-by-gene matrix exceeds INFERENCE_SCEPTRE_MAX_MATRIX_ENTRIES. off keeps a single input. force chunks regardless of matrix size.

INFERENCE_SCEPTRE_MAX_MATRIX_ENTRIES.description: Matrix-size threshold used by SCEPTRE auto chunking.

INFERENCE_SCEPTRE_GENE_CHUNK_SIZE.description: Number of genes per SCEPTRE chunk when chunking is enabled.

INFERENCE_SCEPTRE_FORCE_CHUNK.description: Force SCEPTRE chunking regardless of matrix size.
INFERENCE_SCEPTRE_FORCE_CHUNK.help_text: This is a compatibility flag that passes --force-chunk to chunk_mudata_sceptre.py.

benchmark_options.title: Benchmark options
benchmark_options.description: Optional transcription-factor benchmark analysis against ENCODE BED files.

ENABLE_BENCHMARK.description: Run the transcription factor benchmark workflow after inference.

ENCODE_BED_DIR.description: Directory containing ENCODE BED files used by the optional benchmark workflow.

network_options.title: Network plot options
network_options.description: Network-display settings used by dashboard/evaluation plots.

NETWORK_custom_central_nodes.description: Comma-separated custom central nodes to highlight in network plots.

NETWORK_central_nodes_num.description: Number of central nodes to highlight when NETWORK_custom_central_nodes is undefined.
